reviewed_by: Codex coordinator, 2026-10-07; all 252 exact field/text judgments inspected against data-contract.md. Availability only, never threshold verdicts or source admission.

classification_contract.partial: A required component of the field is absent; source statements limited to other phases do not fill this condition.
classification_contract.present: Reported value; not necessarily a comparable value. Continuous light needs no photoperiod, stationary growth needs no OD; OD730/A730 accepted like OD750.
classification_contract.medium: Named medium counts as present; an unresolved recipe or nitrogen/carbon comparison remains a screen blocker.
classification_contract.review: All values reviewed; exact values only. Five model overrides use the contract. Bare OD without named phase or maintenance is partial. Explicitly missing sampling/labeling OD remains partial even when phase and an earlier/maintenance OD are stated. Volume disagreement does not erase agreement on liquid format. No keyword inference at ranking time. Availability is not source admission.
